# Support

Thanks for taking an interest in this project. This document explains where to
go for help, depending on what you're trying to do.

> **TL;DR:** Bugs and feature requests → issue templates. Vulnerabilities →
> [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md). General questions → email.

## Documentation

Before opening an issue, check the existing docs:

| Doc | Use it for |
| --- | --- |
| [README](../README.md) | Project overview, what the site does, the live-maintenance-header signal flow |
| [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) | Local setup, running, branching, commits, PR process, style |
| [CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md](../CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md) | Behaviour standards and reporting |
| [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md) | Private vulnerability disclosure |
| [GOVERNANCE.md](../GOVERNANCE.md) | How decisions are made |
| [MAINTAINERS.md](../MAINTAINERS.md) | Who owns which area of the repo |

## Reporting a bug

Use the **🐛 Bug report** issue template:

→ [Open a bug report](https://github.com/MA1002643/theabdullahfolio/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml)

Provide:

- The exact reproduction steps (numbered).
- Browser, OS, device, and viewport width.
- Screenshots or a short video for any visual bug.
- Confirmation that you've reproduced against the latest commit on `main`.

## Proposing a feature

Use the **✨ Feature request** template:

→ [Open a feature request](https://github.com/MA1002643/theabdullahfolio/issues/new?template=feature_request.yml)

Lead with the user-facing problem, not the implementation. Include
acceptance criteria so "done" is unambiguous.

## Suggesting a UI / UX refinement

For polish on existing UI (animation timing, layout, motion behaviour), use
the dedicated **🎨 UI / UX improvement** template:

→ [Open a UI/UX improvement](https://github.com/MA1002643/theabdullahfolio/issues/new?template=ui_ux_improvement.yml)

Include reference screenshots and specific motion expectations (timing,
easing, stagger).

## Improving documentation

For docs gaps, inaccuracies, or expansions, use the **📚 Documentation
improvement** template:

→ [Open a docs issue](https://github.com/MA1002643/theabdullahfolio/issues/new?template=docs_improvement.yml)

## Reporting a security vulnerability

**Do not file a public issue for security bugs.**

→ [Open a private GitHub Security Advisory](https://github.com/MA1002643/theabdullahfolio/security/advisories/new)

or email **team@ma.codes** with `SECURITY` in the subject line.

Full details in [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md), including response timelines
and out-of-scope items.

## General questions

For anything that isn't a bug, feature, or vulnerability — e.g. "how does
the work-status route decide between LIVE and IN_PROGRESS?" — email
**team@ma.codes** with a clear subject line.

Please don't open an issue with "question" in the title — those clutter the
tracker and rarely get answered faster than email.

## Response expectations

This is a personal portfolio project maintained part-time. Realistic timelines:

| Channel | Acknowledgement target |
| --- | --- |
| Security advisory / email with `SECURITY` subject | within 72 hours |
| Bug / feature / UI issue | within 7 days |
| General question email | best-effort, may be slower |

These are targets, not guarantees. Critical-severity security reports are
prioritised over everything else.
